2607.14739.title: FoMoVLA: Bridging Visual Foresight and Motion Guidance for Vision-Language-Action Models
2607.14739.paper_summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved impressive results in visuomotor policy learning, yet remain fundamentally reactive, mapping current observations and language to actions without explicit forward prediction of world dynamics. Existing visual foresight methods predict future visual states but lack explicit motion guidance: they show where to go but not how to get there. We argue that future feature prediction and sparse point tracking are naturally complementary: the former provides the goal state, while the latter captures the continuous motion path toward it. We propose FoMoVLA, a framework that augments VLA representations with explicit spatio-temporal supervision by jointly learning future feature foresight and sparse 2D point tracking, enhancing the continuous action policy. FoMoVLA introduces compact foresight tokens to decode future feature states, decodes sparse temporal 2D point trajectories to model compact geometric motion, and couples both through a lightweight future-conditioned cross-attention module that enables consistent reasoning between anticipated states and point dynamics. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, RoboCasa GR-1 Tabletop, and LIBERO-Plus demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and strong zero-shot generalization. Project page is available at https://liauto-research.github.io/FoMoVLA.
2607.14739.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言-行動（VLA）模型在視覺運動策略學習中取得了令人印象深刻的成果，但仍然基本上是反應性的，將當前觀察和語言映射到行動，而不明確預測世界動態。現有的視覺預見方法預測未來的視覺狀態，但缺乏明確的運動指導：它們顯示了要去的地方，但不告訴我們如何到達那裡。我們認為未來特徵預測和稀疏點追蹤是自然互補的：前者提供了目標狀態，而後者捕捉了通往該狀態的連續運動路徑。我們提出了FoMoVLA，一個通過共同學習未來特徵預見和稀疏2D點追蹤來增強VLA表示的框架，從而增強連續行動策略。FoMoVLA引入了緊湊的預見標記來解碼未來特徵狀態，解碼稀疏的時間2D點軌跡以建模緊湊的幾何運動，並通過輕量級的未來條件交叉注意模塊將兩者結合，實現預期狀態與點動態之間的一致推理。在LIBERO、RoboCasa GR-1桌面和LIBERO-Plus上的大量實驗顯示了最先進的性能和強大的零樣本泛化。項目頁面可在 https://liauto-research.github.io/FoMoVLA 獲得。
